title: Fluctuations of subgraph counts in exponential random graphs
summary: In this paper, we study fluctuations of fixed subgraph counts in dense exponential random graphs on $n$ vertices. We compare each normalized subgraph count $V$ with the normalized edge count $W$: their difference $V-W$ is $O(n^{-1/2})$ in $L^2$, whereas $\mathbb{E}[(V-W)f(W)]=O(n^{-1})$ for every $1$-Lipschitz function $f$. We also obtain $O(n^{-1})$ Kolmogorov and Wasserstein bounds, optimal for the edge count, with relative variance error of the same order.
